# The hose route crosses the seating area

Our efficient hose route makes a trip hazard beside the chairs. Watering at a quiet time reduces the risk but doesn't change the layout. Tried two shorter hoses with a connection by the wall. [[Garden notebook]]: the best route for water can be a bad route for people. Test the ordinary busy afternoon, not the empty plot.
